title: UserGems launches its redesigned AI Chrome Extension
summary: Gem-E now works inside Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft and Gong: reasons to engage, ranked contacts and signal to sequence in one click.
body_markdown:
**UserGems launches its redesigned AI Chrome Extension, putting Gem-E inside Salesforce, HubSpot and every rep's sales engagement tool.**


*Reps see who to contact, why now and what to say on one screen, then go from buying signal to a personalized sequence in one click.*


**SAN FRANCISCO, November 20th 2026:** UserGems, the AI command center for outbound and ABM, has launched its redesigned AI Chrome Extension, now live for all customers. The new design opens a full-height panel next to any person or company in Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft and Gong Engage. The panel shows reps who to contact, why now and what to say, and the Gem-E Writing Agent drafts the messages and adds the prospect to a sequence without the rep leaving the page.


A new two-minute demo video, *What does the UserGems AI Chrome Extension do?* , shows it in action:


**What's in the video**


1. Prioritized accounts and contacts inside the CRM and sales engagement tools reps already use.
2. The buying signals behind each pick, such as competitor research, pricing page visits, past product experience and new colleagues.
3. Account scores and what's driving them.
4. Finding more people to reach the full buying committee.
5. Deal insights from past conversations and research from the Gem-E Research Agent.
6. Gem-E turning signals into personalized emails and LinkedIn connection requests, and answering questions about the account.


Reps spend their day moving between the CRM and their sales engagement tool, while the buying signals that should decide who they contact sit in another tab. Research eats the morning, personalization gets skipped and good signals go cold. The problem is rarely missing data. It's that the data isn't where the rep is working.


**What's new**


- **Everything on one screen.** A full-height panel shows signals, AI reasons to engage and the right people to contact, right next to the record the rep already has open.
- **AI reasons to engage.** Gem-E explains why to reach out to this person now, drawing on their buying signals, CRM history and company news.
- **The right people, ranked.** Suggested contacts are the top-scored prospects at the account, based on the customer's own scoring model, who aren't in a sequence yet.
- **Signal to sequence in one click.** Reps choose their instructions and a sequence. The Gem-E Writing Agent writes every step to match the sequence's order and channels, including call and LinkedIn-only sequences. Reps review, edit and add the prospect in one step.
- **Ready for calls and one-off messages.** Call briefings and one-off emails sit alongside sequences, so reps have talking points before they dial.
- **Instant enrichment.** Open a person or company UserGems has never tracked and the data appears right away.
- **Search and go.** Reps can jump to companies and people straight from the search bar.
- **Deeper company views.** Company pages show an overview, the people to reach, deal intel and research (deal intel and research depend on plan).


**Built for sales leaders too**


Every prospect opened, created or sequenced from the extension is logged with the rep who did it, so leaders can see adoption from day one and filter campaign logs by source. Admins can also give team members extension-only access.


**One motion with marketing**


The extension runs on the same UserGems Live Identity Graph and scoring that power Gem-E for ABM. When marketing marks an account as in market, reps see the same priority, the same buying group and the same reasons in their own tools, so sales and marketing finally work from one view.[The extension appears in the Gem-E for ABM walkthrough.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q7EbWUrhobI)


**Results teams are seeing with Gem-E**


- Around 2,000 people use the UserGems extension, according to its Chrome Web Store listing.
- Sendoso reached 20% reply rates on outbound powered by Gem-E.
- Docebo sees 11 to 16% reply rates with UserGems.
- UserGems' own ADR team doubled its outbound capacity in 10 months.


"The UserGems Chrome extension does all of the research for my team, it continues with the extension taking around 90% of the team's research and admin" said Jane Serra, Global Head of Marketing at MemoryBlue.


"UserGems writes extremely great emails. You make me want to be BDR again, honestly," said Simona Gatta, Global Senior Director of Business Development at Docebo.


**Availability**


The redesigned AI Chrome Extension is live now for all UserGems customers and updates automatically. AI add to sequence is available to customers using the Gem-E Writing Agent. Reps need a UserGems account and a license for Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft or Gong Engage.[Install it from the Chrome Web Store.](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/usergems-ai-copilot-chrom/mfafgbnpmniemelmlmnekmcefkjoaope)
